exclusions.name: Hycroft Mine
exclusions.reason: Mining ceased in November 2021. February 2026 technical report concerns a resource update, not a restart.

exclusions.name: Jerritt Canyon Mine
exclusions.reason: Operator April 2026 restart plan targets production in the second half of 2027; preparatory spending is not operating production.

exclusions.name: Pumpkin Hollow Mine
exclusions.reason: Operator January 2026 permit project plan describes pre-operational phase and planned 2027 processing restart. No verified completed restart as of review.

exclusions.name: Relief Canyon Mine
exclusions.reason: Operator 2025 AIF published March 2026 identifies care and maintenance; operations suspended August 2021.

exclusions.name: Ruby Hill Mines
exclusions.reason: September 22, 2026 operator release describes the Archimedes mine under construction with first production anticipated Q4. Residual historic heap leaching is not evidence of current mine extraction.

exclusions.name: Castle Mountain Mine
exclusions.reason: Mining suspended August 2024; operator Q1 2026 financial statements report care and maintenance with residual leach revenue.

exclusions.name: Ashdown Mine
exclusions.reason: Held for further status review: the mirrored row cites a 2011 SEC source and a stock forum, insufficient to resolve contradictory closure reporting. This omission is not a newly inferred closure date.

notes: Coordinates are independent of operating status. ICMM is used solely as a coordinate/name reference.
No nearest-neighbour-only or mine-group-name joins are accepted.
Meikle is an individually named underground mine within the wider Goldstrike complex; it is not automatically merged with the complex.
